2. The strip with "Лучший круг", "Больше всего позиций", "На финише" must be much shorter, around 5–6% of canvas height. Use three equal columns, small headings, moderately sized values and compact driver names; no huge statistic numbers or wasted vertical space.

All 22 drivers must be represented, no missing drivers.
